scripts.build:all: nx build ng-prism && nx run-many -t build --projects='plugin-box-model,plugin-figma,plugin-jsdoc,plugin-perfm,plugin-coverage'
scripts.check: nx format:check && nx run-many -t test build typecheck
scripts.test:workspace:kill: lsof -ti :4400 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || echo 'No process on port 4400'
scripts.test:workspace:install: cd test-workspace && npm install && (test -f ng-prism.config.ts || cp ng-prism.config.example.ts ng-prism.config.ts)
scripts.test:workspace:update: nx run-many -t build --projects='ng-prism,plugin-box-model,plugin-coverage,plugin-figma,plugin-jsdoc,plugin-perf' && cd test-workspace && rm -rf .angular/cache && npm install --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.test:workspace:serve: cd test-workspace && npx ng run test-lib:prism
scripts.test:workspace:build: cd test-workspace && npx ng run test-lib:prism-build
scripts.test:workspace:clean: cd test-workspace && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json ng-prism.config.ts && git checkout -- angular.json package.json
scripts.test:workspace:reset: npm run test:workspace:clean && npm run test:workspace:setup && npm run test:workspace:install
